question: How does the Lord's will unfold into knowledge and action?
premises: The same creative impulse turns outward.
This outward turning is identified as will.
Will assumes the nature of knowledge and action.
inference: That very impulse, turning outward as will, becomes the nature of knowledge and action.
uncertainties: The initial consonant in conmukhatāṃ reflects sandhi within the transmitted token.
plain_english: That very impulse turns outward and becomes will, taking on the nature of knowledge and action.
